L1-R-S1-01.B: 3/4 is a fraction, so it is not a whole number.
L1-R-S1-01.C: 0.6 is a decimal. It has a part after the decimal point.
L1-R-S1-01.D: 12% means 12/100, which is part of a whole, not a whole number.

L1-R-S1-02.A: -12 is the same number. The opposite has the other sign.
L1-R-S1-02.B: 0 is the middle of the number line, not the opposite of -12.
L1-R-S1-02.D: 1/12 turns it into a fraction. Opposites only change the sign.

L1-R-S1-03.A: Absolute value is a distance, so it is never negative.
L1-R-S1-03.C: Only |0| is 0. -9 is 9 steps away from zero.
L1-R-S1-03.D: Absolute value does not make a fraction. Count the steps to zero.

L1-R-S5-01.B: This goes from greatest to least, the reverse order.
L1-R-S5-01.C: -6 is less than -2, so -6 must come first.
L1-R-S5-01.D: -2 is less than 0, so -2 must come before 0.

L1-R-S5-02.A: -7 is farther left, so it is smaller, not greater.
L1-R-S5-02.B: -7 and -3 are different points on the number line.
L1-R-S5-02.D: -3 is to the right of -7, so -3 is the greater one.

L1-R-S5-03.A: -6 is farthest left, so it is the smallest.
L1-R-S5-03.B: -1 is left of zero, so it is less than 3 and 6.
L1-R-S5-03.C: 3 is positive, but 6 is farther right.

L1-A-S1-01.B: 2.5 has a decimal part, so it is not a whole number.
L1-A-S1-01.C: 1/3 is a fraction, not a whole number.
L1-A-S1-01.D: 7.1% is a percentage with a decimal, not a whole number.

L1-A-S1-02.A: That is the same point. The opposite is on the other side of zero.
L1-A-S1-02.B: 0 is the middle point, not the opposite of -4.
L1-A-S1-02.D: 8 is twice as far. The opposite is the same distance from zero: 4.

L1-A-S1-03.A: Distance is never negative, so drop the minus sign.
L1-A-S1-03.D: 28 doubles the number. Absolute value only removes the sign.

L1-A-S5-01.B: This is least to greatest, the reverse order.
L1-A-S5-01.C: 0 is greater than -1, so 0 comes before -1.
L1-A-S5-01.D: 5 is greater than 0, so 5 comes first.

L1-A-S5-02.A: -2 is to the right of -8, so -2 is greater.
L1-A-S5-02.B: Negative numbers are always less than 0.
L1-A-S5-02.D: 0 is to the right of -8, so 0 is greater.

L1-A-S5-03.A: -4 is the leftmost point, so it is the smallest value.
L1-A-S5-03.C: 7 is the rightmost point, so it is the greatest value.
L1-A-S5-03.D: -7 is not one of the plotted values.

L1-F-S1-01.B: Zero is a whole number, not a fraction.
L1-F-S1-01.D: Zero is a whole number, so it is not only a percentage.

L1-F-S1-02.A: That is the same number. Change the sign to get the opposite.
L1-F-S1-02.C: 0 is the middle, not the opposite of 5.
L1-F-S1-02.D: 10 is farther away. The opposite keeps the same distance: 5.

L1-F-S1-03.A: Distance can't be negative, so drop the minus sign.
L1-F-S1-03.D: 6 doubles it. Count only the steps from -3 to 0.

L1-F-S5-01.A: -5 is farther left, so it is the smaller one.
L1-F-S5-01.C: They are different points, so they can't be equal.
L1-F-S5-01.D: 0 is not one of the two numbers being compared.

L1-F-S5-02.A: This goes from greatest to least, the reverse order.
L1-F-S5-02.B: 0 is less than 2, so 0 comes before 2.
L1-F-S5-02.D: -3 is less than 0, so -3 comes first.

L1-F-S5-03.B: -4 is left of 1, so it is smaller, not greater.
L1-F-S5-03.C: -4 and 1 are different numbers, so they are not equal.
L1-F-S5-03.D: + is an operation, not a comparison symbol.

L2-R-S2-01.B: -11 subtracts 7 from 18. Both numbers are negative, so add: 18 + 7.
L2-R-S2-01.C: 11 is 18 - 7. Same signs mean add the distances and keep the sign.
L2-R-S2-01.D: The distances add to 25, but both numbers are negative, so keep the minus.

L2-R-S2-02.A: -23 treats 14 as negative. Adding 14 moves right, not left.
L2-R-S2-02.B: The sign is off. 14 is bigger than 9, so the answer is positive.
L2-R-S2-02.D: 23 adds the distances. Different signs mean subtract: 14 - 9.

L2-R-S2-03.A: -43 adds -12. Subtracting a negative means adding 12.
L2-R-S2-03.C: The distance 19 is right, but -31 is farther from zero, so the answer is negative.

L2-R-S3-01.B: 7 x 6 = 42, but the signs are different, so the product is negative.
L2-R-S3-01.C: -13 comes from adding. The question asks you to multiply.

L2-R-S3-02.A: 48 / 8 = 6, and same signs give a positive answer.
L2-R-S3-02.C: -40 comes from subtracting. The question asks you to divide.

L2-R-S3-03.B: Four groups of a negative number stay negative: 4 x (-3) = -12.
L2-R-S3-03.C: -7 comes from adding. Equal groups mean multiply: 4 x (-3).
L2-R-S3-03.D: 7 is 4 + 3. Four equal groups means multiply.

L2-A-S2-01.A: -33 treats 9 as negative. Adding 9 moves right from -24.
L2-A-S2-01.C: 24 - 9 = 15, but -24 is farther from zero, so the answer is negative.
L2-A-S2-01.D: 33 adds the distances. Different signs mean subtract: 24 - 9.

L2-A-S2-02.B: Subtracting a negative makes the number bigger: 17 + 6.
L2-A-S2-02.D: The distance 23 is right, but 17 + 6 is positive.
